name: storm-deepresearch-skill
description: Governed STORM research harness with bounded or open-ended full dossiers, tasklets, findings pool, receipt chains, evidence ledgers, validated Markdown/HTML/PDF, and trust-approved release.
author: 陈旭
input_files: User files or URLs, retrieval records, STORM findings, absence-search records, explicit assurance target, captured execution and review provenance, trust evidence, and human approval records.
output_contract: Workspace run with generation artifacts, tasklets, findings pool, receipt chain, evidence ledgers, explicit achieved assurance, Markdown/HTML/full PDF, validation, and allowlisted release.
rollback_boundary: Restore the archived 3.0.0 package for 3.x runs; 4.0 open-ended length contracts remain governed by 4.0.
trust_requirement: Release requires Yao Trust, registry hash match, validation receipt binding, and human approval.
